reviews.title: Incredible exhaust fan.
reviews.comment: Excellent exhaust fan, it looks very nice when properly tuned, keeps my case cool, and it wasn’t super hard to install. Under load, it does produce a bit of noise, but it is overall quiet and does an incredible job of keeping my case cool.
reviews.author: Steve K

reviews.title: Great PC fans
reviews.comment: Great argb. Great value. Great quiet sound, nothing wrong with the Arctic P14 Pro a-rgb fans at all! Super functional and power is nice because it can spin fast if you set the fan curves. The length is just right.
reviews.author: Deejay

reviews.title: Quality fans at a budget price
reviews.comment: Quality fans at a budget price. I got 8 of these in my Havn 420. They function well and noise level is not bad at all unless they have to ramp up due to load, but that is usually for only 10-20 seconds depending what is happening. The cable length is perfect and the way they daisy chain together is great. The RGB color is perfectly matched to the ram and motherboard in my system. They look great!
reviews.author: Patrick Cook

reviews.title: Doesn't let my 9950x3d2 hit 95c
reviews.comment: Looks good ... Great temps systems runs cool... Excellent lighting I even have the Arctic liquid freeze pro 420 aRGB cooling the new 9950x3d2 dual edition using all Arctic cooling
reviews.author: Luis...

reviews.title: Loud but effective
reviews.comment: Brought this for use as a rear exhaust fan and for that it’s a job well done. The leds are plenty bright and colors vibrant. Easy to configure through motherboard software. They move a lot of air but at default speeds they are extremely loud. I set a curve an and now they are much quieter will still moving a good amount of air.
reviews.author: Sam Frederic
